scope: Experimental host buffer topology; no firmware, switching or specimen qualification
findings: The original generic input transistor reverse beta fails the D104 high-input-current condition. The explicit 0.01 reverse-beta candidate passes the selected DC conditions at 25 C; neither proves applicability across temperature or process.

Adding the experimental host buffer makes all retained sampled buffer-input extrema fit the static D104 voltage envelope and preserves settled output inversion for both driver fixtures and cable loads.
Passing the waveform voltage envelope does not calibrate the generic diode clamp, transistor storage, propagation, SIO input loads or host winding parameters.

The initial DC fixture used the wrong sign for datasheet output load current and is rejected. Corrected fixtures load VOH by drawing current and VOL by injecting current; the regression check preserves this distinction.
nextAction: Qualify buffer switching and input clamp/loading behavior independently, then connect the sourced host boundary to firmware observation without treating illustrative SIO loads as historical measurements.
